method: Evidence from the release files; the reviewed 3.1.142 is no longer downloadable, so each fact of that review was re-checked against 3.1.200; one Sonnet 5.5 agent established the facts with exact quotes; every quote checked against the release files and README by script; the facts that set the level checked again by hand; level from the fixed rule; label and summary written by Claude Opus 5.5.
label: A zotero:// link (a web page can open one) can make it run code, but only after asking you
summary: Its zotero://ztoolkit-debug link, from a bundled toolkit, runs the JavaScript it carries, but first shows you the command in a confirm box (or needs a matching password setting). The plugin's own zotero://meet-awesome-gpt link no longer runs code: since 3.1.200 it only opens the item a citation link points to, where 3.1.142 ran whatever code the link carried without asking.

facts.handler: zotero://ztoolkit-debug, the debug bridge of the bundled zotero-plugin-toolkit; reads run (code) or file from the link
facts.check: asks first: unless a password is set, a confirm box shows the command and 'If you do not know what it is, please click Cancel to deny'; when a password setting is set, the link must carry the same password or nothing runs. The plugin sets disableDebugBridgePassword to false, so that check stays on
facts.runs: new AsyncFunction("Zotero,window", run) with Zotero's full privileges, after the prompt or password

quotes.text: l=o.confirm(`External App ${a.app} wants to execute command without password.

facts.otherLink: zotero://meet-awesome-gpt (the plugin's own link) no longer runs code: it decrypts its data with AES-GCM under a key made from the phrase by-polygon, written into the plugin, but then accepts only a canvas-citation JSON or a Zotero.Reader.open(id, {position}) string matched by a regular expression, and opens that item or reader position; anything else throws. Anyone can still make such a link, but the most it does is open an item.

otherQuotes.text: throw new Error("Unsupported Canvas link payload")

facts.notes: zoterogpt.js lines 1824-1827: the toolkit's ztoolkit-debug handler (the prompt at 1824; the password check, the code run and the registration at 1827, where the scanner's evidence is); line 3048: disableDebugBridgePassword set to false; line 1234: the meet-awesome-gpt handler. The reviewed 3.1.142 ran the decrypted source of meet-awesome-gpt links with no prompt (new AsyncFunction("Zotero","window",source)); that release file is no longer downloadable, the tag now serves 3.1.200. The developer was asked on 2026-11-03 to replace the GitHub release file (MuiseDestiny/zotero-gpt#526).
